explanation: It is 0 everywhere except at D1 in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 86 onward, mostly 94-99) when the agent keeps choosing a2; there it is high if the previous trial was a common a2-to-S2 transition: about 8 the first time it was rewarded, 10 on following rewarded trials, and still 10 after an unrewarded common trial that came right after rewarded ones (around trials 86-88 it only reaches 4-5). It is 0 at D1 when the previous trial was a rare transition (a2 to S1), or when it was unrewarded and the trial before that was too, and it is always 0 at GO and D2, before trial ~85, and whenever the agent is choosing a1.
